surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the adsorption of precursor molecules followed by surface reactions. The ALD process uses Al(CH3)3 and H2O as precursors. The Al(CH3)3 precursor reacts with surface hydroxyl groups, and the H2O precursor reacts with the surface to regenerate hydroxyl groups. The reaction equations are not explicitly provided in the text.
